Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building and site data, with extensive condition assessments and phased capital planning integrating immediate and long-term needs (Chunks 1-3, 22-26).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed 10-year enrollment projections by study area with demographic, mobility, and residential development data; capacity linked to specific facility actions and adaptive uses (Chunks 46-56).

Educational Alignment.justification: Plan references educational goals broadly and includes some programmatic considerations, but lacks detailed educational specifications or direct connection of projects to educational programs.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and strategies for outdoor improvements such as new grass playfields, shade structures, and landscaping at multiple sites, though not fully districtwide or deeply integrated with climate resilience (Chunks 4-6, 14-15).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related risks and includes some mitigation strategies like shade structures and drainage improvements, but lacks comprehensive district-wide climate risk assessment or integrated resilience planning (Chunks 4, 14).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Plan includes energy efficiency upgrades (LED lighting, HVAC), references Title 24 and ZNE goals, and mentions energy resilience goals, but lacks comprehensive district-wide data and detailed resilience strategies (Chunks 2, 17).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates with escalation and contingencies, clear project prioritization, multiple funding sources including bonds and state programs, and long-term financial sustainability analysis (Chunks 2, 101-106).
